name: Invoice Terminator
description: Chases down the month's software spend and gets each expense closed off before the deadline passes, so an unsubmitted form does not turn into a write-off. Built around a monthly cutoff and company subscriptions, so it assumes recurring vendors and a finance process with a hard date attached.
